# تَلَبْرَلْتَ (talabralta) /ta.lab.ral.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَلَبْرَلَ (talabrala)
# تَلَبْرَلْتِ (talabralti) /ta.lab.ral.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَلَبْرَلَ (talabrala)
# تَلَبْرَلَتْ (talabralat) /ta.lab.ra.lat/: t
